meta.purpose: Dated Booking.com third-party quote snapshots for comparing selected hotel/date pairs; this dataset alone does not establish the cheapest week across Las Vegas.
meta.method: Booking.com searches for whole weeks, 2 adults, 1 room, USD, sorted by price, captured 2026-11-25. These are not official property-engine quotes. Only properties that appeared in a captured result block are listed; see F-29 for the conflicting official-engine sample.
meta.caveat: The user's stated window is 2027-02-15 → 2027-03-23. Everything outside that range is excluded. The four Booking.com windows below sit inside it; 22 Feb–1 Mar was not sampled in this dataset.

lowest_sampled_ota_quotes.scope: Among the selected Booking.com room/date snapshots only; the same sampled rooms at Venetian ($2,407 vs $3,757), Palazzo ($2,422 vs $3,932), and Cosmopolitan ($2,307 vs $3,433) had lower W3 quotes.

derived.w1_quote_note: W1 (15–22 Feb) is higher than W3 in these selected OTA snapshots for Venetian, Palazzo and Cosmopolitan, but this is not an overall market or official-rate finding. Other official property-engine samples conflict.
derived.anomaly: Nobu at Caesars Palace is cheaper in the sampled W1 Booking.com quote ($1,125) than W3 ($1,750). No explanation verified — flagged F-12.
derived.recommendation: Do not move dates based on this partial OTA snapshot. Compare the same named room and fee/tax basis at each hotel's official booking engine; the official-engine sample conflicts with the OTA result and no market-wide cheapest date is established.
